 Oral Order

(Per: HONOURABLE THE ACTING CHIEF JUSTICE )
4 15-10-2015 Ref: I.A. No.8608 of 2015 The writ petitioner/applicant has sought for correction by way of amendment of the cause title of writ petition by substituting the sole respondent, The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Heard Mr. Prabhat Ranjan, learned Counsel, appearing on behalf of the petitioner-applicant, and Mr.Brisketu Sharan Pandey, learned Counsel, appearing on behalf of the Respondent. Heard also Mrs. Nivedita Nirvikar, learned Central Government Counsel, appearing on behalf of the Union of India.

Prayer for correction of cause title by way of amendment is hereby allowed inasmuch as amendment, so allowed, would not change the nature or character of the proceeding nor would the amendment add a new cause of action.
In terms of the above observations and directions, I.A. No.8608 of 2015 stands disposed of.
Let the corrections be made accordingly.

C.W.J.C. No.3805 of 2015 On the request jointly made by learned Counsel for the parties concerned,
this case is directed to be listed, on 30.10.2015, under the present heading.
